tools.name: spanner.execute_sql
tools.title: Execute SQL on Spanner
tools.description: Runs a read-only GoogleSQL query on Google Cloud Spanner and returns at most 1,000 rows. Use this when a question needs data from the orders database.

region.description: Region to run the query in, for example us-west1

tools.name: spanner.update_row
tools.title: Update row
tools.description: Updates the named columns of one row, only if its commit timestamp still matches. Use this when changing a single order. A retry with the same expected_commit_ts fails with a conflict instead of writing twice.

expected_commit_ts.description: Commit timestamp from the last read

tools.name: spanner.estimate_cost
tools.title: Estimate cost
tools.description: Estimates the cost of a query in USD. Use this when the user asks what a query will cost before running it.
